name: Hail the Dragonslayer
summary: Cedric Dalton at the Southern Watch asks you to bring him Scaldaron’s head. The dragon’s threat is gone, and the sentries should hear what happened.

sections.title: Word at the Watch
sections.body: Scaldaron’s head is a grisly sign of the danger that has passed. At the Southern Watch, Cedric Dalton learns what happened when you bring it to him. The sentries there had thought gnolls in the hills were their only concern.

faq.q: Who is asking for Scaldaron’s head?
faq.answer: Cedric Dalton at the Southern Watch asks you to bring him the Head of Scaldaron.

faq.q: Where should I take the Head of Scaldaron?
faq.answer: Take the Head of Scaldaron to Cedric Dalton at the Southern Watch.
Scaldaron was a dragon whose threat is now gone.

faq.q: Why should the sentries hear what happened?
faq.answer: The Southern Watch sentries should know what happened after Scaldaron’s threat ended.

attribution: In-game quest text: Hail the Dragonslayer
